# Temple of Sun

> Holistic wellness by Péter Frák: hand-blended aromatherapy formulas, one-to-one healing treatments, meditation classes and Soul Alchemy Retreats, practised between Portugal and Hungary. Every blend is made from 100% pure, laboratory-tested essential oils, composed in a meditative state.

Full site content in one document: https://templeofsun.com/llms-full.txt

Temple of Sun (templeofsun) is the practice of Péter Frák, a certified aromatherapist (Panarom Budapest, 2-year diploma), member of the International Federation of Aromatherapists (IFA), Ayurvedic and Marma-Abhyanga massage therapist (Mysore Ayurveda Academy, India), Reiki practitioner since age fifteen and holder of a Universal Reiki teacher diploma from the Atemi Martial Arts Budo Academy in Hungary (2025), where he is listed among their teachers, and rebirthing breath-work facilitator. He has supported more than fifty retreats in the Portuguese mountains and holds space at Quinta da Comporta and JNcQUOI. In 2024 he created the Jivamukti Essence, the official aroma oil of Jivamukti Yoga, sold in their European shop. He was an invited speaker at ELLE Yoga Weekend – Ride the Fire, organised by ELLE Hungary in Budapest in May 2026, and appeared as the invited expert on aromatherapy and massage therapy on the Karc FM talk show Összhang in November 2022.

Sessions run in English, Hungarian and German.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://templeofsun.com/): overview of the oils, treatments and retreats, with 28 named guest reviews
- [Aromatherapy, an introduction](https://templeofsun.com/aromatherapy.html): what aromatherapy is, its history, how scent works on body and mind, oil safety
- [The Collections](https://templeofsun.com/collections.html): overview of the two blend collections
- [The Rainbow Collection](https://templeofsun.com/rainbow-collection.html): 18 hand-blended formulas made around feelings (sleep, focus, grief, confidence), born from a 2020 New Year's ceremony in India; includes the "constellation of 74" showing the shared plants between blends
- [The 5 Elements](https://templeofsun.com/5-elements.html): five Ayurvedic element formulas (Earth, Water, Fire, Air, Ether) mapped to the chakras
- [Find Your Blend](https://templeofsun.com/find-your-blend.html): eight questions that point you to the blend closest to what you need right now
- [Create Your Own Formula](https://templeofsun.com/create-your-own-formula.html): bespoke signature scents for studios, hotels and practices
- [The Jivamukti collaboration](https://templeofsun.com/jivamukti-collaboration.html): the full story of the Jivamukti Essence
- [Treatments](https://templeofsun.com/treatments.html): one-to-one aromatherapy and Ayurvedic massage treatments, including Anahata
- [Soul Alchemy Retreats](https://templeofsun.com/retreats.html): small-group healing retreats in Portugal, with guest video testimonials
- [Online Sessions](https://templeofsun.com/online-sessions.html): distance healing and guidance, one to one; three separate programmes, listed below
- [Holistic Health Consultation](https://templeofsun.com/health-consultation.html): a one-time, one-hour online Ayurveda-based consultation covering constitution, habits, health history and personalised aromatherapy suggestions
- [Spiritual Mentoring & Transformation](https://templeofsun.com/spiritual-mentoring.html): a three-month one-to-one programme, six 60-minute online sessions plus an introduction call, with four bespoke 5ml formulas
- [Meditation Guidance](https://templeofsun.com/meditation-guidance.html): a one-week one-to-one programme, 40 minutes daily online, Tibetan Buddhist foundations with Pranayama breathing
- [Meditation Classes](https://templeofsun.com/meditation.html): guided meditation
- [Mindfulness LABs](https://templeofsun.com/mindfulness-labs.html): mindfulness classes for venues and their guests
- [My Story](https://templeofsun.com/bio.html): Péter Frák in his own words — the path from a Reiki initiation at fifteen through the fashion years to aromatherapy and Ayurveda, with full credentials, training and press
- [Philosophy](https://templeofsun.com/philosophy.html): the five beliefs behind the practice
- [The essence of you](https://templeofsun.com/the-essence-of-you.html): a prose poem written for Péter by the author and curator Diana Murray Watts, during a retreat in Mora, Portugal, May 2026
- [Questions & Answers](https://templeofsun.com/faq.html): searchable FAQ covering the blends, safety, orders, sessions, retreats and custom work
- [Contact](https://templeofsun.com/contact.html): write to Péter directly; WhatsApp +36 70 287 9225, email templeofsunofficial@gmail.com

Invited speaker; session "Mindfulness laboratórium – a belső teremtő tűz fellobbantása" (Mindfulness Laboratory: igniting the inner creative fire). ELLE's speaker feature (Hungarian): https://elle.hu/eletmod/elle-yoga-weekend-ride-the-fire-2026-majus-eloadok

## Notes

- The 23 blends are priced €29.50 to €40.60 and described on the two collection pages, each with named plants, rituals of use and cautions.
- Aromatherapy at Temple of Sun is a complementary practice; it does not replace medical care.
